annotations.title: What is next in a meal plan

description: Say what is next in a meal plan made with plan_meal, and how long until it. Give the plan's code (the last part of its link). Only reads; never changes a plan. Give the control key too, if you have it, to also see the timers on the phone.

code.description: The plan's code, or its whole link.

key.description: Optional: the plan's secret control key. With it the answer also says whether the person has started the timers on the phone and what each one is doing.

name: meal_status

claimed.description: Only with the key: a phone has tapped Start.

links.description: Each dish that starts after another dish: {dish, number, after, afterNumber, when: 'goes in'|'is done', minutes, text}. Keep these when you change the plan.

timers.description: Only with the key, once the phone has started: each dish's state on the phone.

title: What is next in a meal plan
